Then the LORD said to Moses and Aaron:
And the Lord said to Moses and Aaron,
耶和華曉諭摩西、亞倫說：
“The Israelites are to camp around the Tent of Meeting at a distance from it, each man under his standard, with the banners of his family.
The children of Israel are to put up their tents in the order of their families, by the flags of their fathers' houses, facing the Tent of meeting on every side.
「以色列人要各歸自己的纛下，在本族的旗號那裡，對著會幕的四圍安營。
On the east side, toward the sunrise, the divisions of Judah are to camp under their standard:
Those whose tents are on the east side, looking to the dawn, will be round the flag of the children of Judah, with Nahshon, the son of Amminadab, as their chief.
在東邊，向日出之地，照著軍隊安營的是猶大營的纛。有亞米拿達的兒子拿順作猶大人的首領。
The leader of the descendants of Judah is Nahshon son of Amminadab, and his division numbers 74,600.
The number of his army was seventy-four thousand, six hundred.
他軍隊被數的，共有七萬四千六百名。
The tribe of Issachar will camp next to it. The leader of the Issacharites is Nethanel son of Zuar,
And nearest to him will be the tribe of Issachar, with Nethanel, the son of Zuar, as their chief.
挨著他安營的是以薩迦支派。有蘇押的兒子拿坦業作以薩迦人的首領。
and his division numbers 54,400.
The number of his army was fifty-four thousand, four hundred.
他軍隊被數的，共有五萬四千四百名。
Next will be the tribe of Zebulun. The leader of the Zebulunites is Eliab son of Helon,
After him, the tribe of Zebulun, with Eliab, the son of Helon, as their chief.
又有西布倫支派。希倫的兒子以利押作西布倫人的首領。
and his division numbers 57,400.
The number of his army was fifty-seven thousand, four hundred.
他軍隊被數的，共有五萬七千四百名。
The total number of men in the divisions of the camp of Judah is 186,400; they shall set out first.
The number of all the armies of Judah was a hundred and eighty-six thousand, four hundred. They go forward first.
凡屬猶大營、按著軍隊被數的，共有十八萬六千四百名，要作第一隊往前行。
On the south side, the divisions of Reuben are to camp under their standard:
On the south side is the flag of the children of Reuben, in the order of their armies, with Elizur, the son of Shedeur, as their chief.
「在南邊，按著軍隊是流便營的纛。有示丟珥的兒子以利蓿作流便人的首領。
The leader of the Reubenites is Elizur son of Shedeur, and his division numbers 46,500.
The number of his army was forty-six thousand, five hundred.
他軍隊被數的，共有四萬六千五百名。
The tribe of Simeon will camp next to it. The leader of the Simeonites is Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai,
And nearest to him, the tribe of Simeon, with Shelumiel, the son of Zurishaddai, as their chief.
挨著他安營的是西緬支派。蘇利沙代的兒子示路蔑作西緬人的首領。
and his division numbers 59,300.
The number of his army was fifty-nine thousand, three hundred.
他軍隊被數的，共有五萬九千三百名。
Next will be the tribe of Gad. The leader of the Gadites is Eliasaph son of Deuel,
Then the tribe of Gad, with Eliasaph, son of Reuel, as their chief.
又有迦得支派。丟珥的兒子以利雅薩作迦得人的首領。
and his division numbers 45,650.
The number of his army was forty-five thousand, six hundred and fifty.
他軍隊被數的，共有四萬五千六百五十名，
The total number of men in the divisions of the camp of Reuben is 151,450; they shall set out second.
The number of all the armies of Reuben together came to a hundred and fifty-one thousand, four hundred and fifty. They go forward second.
凡屬流便營、按著軍隊被數的，共有十五萬一千四百五十名，要作第二隊往前行。
In the middle of the camps, the Tent of Meeting is to travel with the camp of the Levites. They are to set out in the order they encamped, each in his own place under his standard.
Then the Tent of meeting is to go forward, with the tents of the Levites, in the middle of the armies; in the same order as their tents are placed, they are to go forward, every man under his flag.
「隨後，會幕要往前行，有利未營在諸營中間。他們怎樣安營就怎樣往前行，各按本位，各歸本纛。
On the west side, the divisions of Ephraim are to camp under their standard:
On the west side will be the flag of the children of Ephraim, with Elishama, the son of Ammihud, as their chief.
「在西邊，按著軍隊是以法蓮營的纛。亞米忽的兒子以利沙瑪作以法蓮人的首領。
The leader of the Ephraimites is Elishama son of Ammihud, and his division numbers 40,500.
The number of his army was forty thousand, five hundred.
他軍隊被數的，共有四萬零五百名。
The tribe of Manasseh will be next to it. The leader of the Manassites is Gamaliel son of Pedahzur,
And by him the tribe of Manasseh with Gamaliel, the son of Pedahzur, as their chief.
挨著他的是瑪拿西支派。比大蓿的兒子迦瑪列作瑪拿西人的首領。
and his division numbers 32,200.
The number of his army was thirty-two thousand, two hundred.
他軍隊被數的，共有三萬二千二百名。
Next will be the tribe of Benjamin. The leader of the Benjamites is Abidan son of Gideoni,
Then the tribe of Benjamin, with Abidan, the son of Gideoni, as their chief.
又有便雅憫支派。基多尼的兒子亞比但作便雅憫人的首領。
and his division numbers 35,400.
The number of his army was thirty-five thousand, four hundred.
他軍隊被數的，共有三萬五千四百名。
The total number of men in the divisions of the camp of Ephraim is 108,100; they shall set out third.
The number of all the armies of Ephraim was a hundred and eight thousand, one hundred. They go forward third.
凡屬以法蓮營、按著軍隊被數的，共有十萬零八千一百名，要作第三隊往前行。
On the north side, the divisions of Dan are to camp under their standard:
On the north side will be the flag of the children of Dan, with Ahiezer, the son of Ammishaddai, as their chief.
「在北邊，按著軍隊是但營的纛。亞米沙代的兒子亞希以謝作但人的首領。
The leader of the Danites is Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai, and his division numbers 62,700.
The number of his army was sixty-two thousand, seven hundred.
他軍隊被數的，共有六萬二千七百名。
The tribe of Asher will camp next to it. The leader of the Asherites is Pagiel son of Ocran,
Nearest to him will be the tribe of Asher, with Pagiel, the son of Ochran, as their chief.
挨著他安營的是亞設支派。俄蘭的兒子帕結作亞設人的首領。
and his division numbers 41,500.
The number of his army was forty-one thousand, five hundred;
他軍隊被數的，共有四萬一千五百名。
Next will be the tribe of Naphtali. The leader of the Naphtalites is Ahira son of Enan,
Then the tribe of Naphtali, with Ahira, the son of Enan, as their chief.
又有拿弗他利支派。以南的兒子亞希拉作拿弗他利人的首領。
and his division numbers 53,400.
The number of his army was fifty-three thousand, four hundred.
他軍隊被數的，共有五萬三千四百名。
The total number of men in the camp of Dan is 157,600; they shall set out last, under their standards.”
The number of all the armies in the tents of Dan was a hundred and fifty-seven thousand, six hundred. They will go forward last, by their flags.
凡但營被數的，共有十五萬七千六百名，要歸本纛作末隊往前行。」
These are the Israelites, numbered according to their families. The total of those counted in the camps, by their divisions, was 603,550.

These are all who were numbered of the children of Israel, in the order of their fathers' families: all the armies in their tents together came to six hundred and three thousand, five hundred and fifty.
這些以色列人，照他們的宗族，按他們的軍隊，在諸營中被數的，共有六十萬零三千五百五十名。
But the Levites were not counted among the other Israelites, as the LORD had commanded Moses.
But the Levites were not numbered among the children of Israel, as the Lord said to Moses.
惟獨利未人沒有數在以色列人中，是照耶和華所吩咐摩西的。
So the Israelites did everything the LORD commanded Moses; they camped under their standards in this way and set out in the same way, each man with his clan and his family.
So the children of Israel did as the Lord said to Moses, so they put up their tents by their flags, and they went forward in the same order, by their families, and by their fathers' houses.
以色列人就這樣行，各人照他們的家室、宗族歸於本纛，安營起行，都是照耶和華所吩咐摩西的。
